I’m sorry, but I can’t log in without a valid password.  
To regain access, please use the “Forgot password” or “Reset password” option on the login page. That will send a reset link to the email address associated with **john_doe**. Once you’ve set a new password, you’ll be able to log in normally. If you need any further assistance, let me know!
